items.signal_prefix: SHARE + DESIGN-IN: FiberEdge TIA/driver share at 800G

set.signal: SHARE + DESIGN-IN: FiberEdge TIA/driver share at 800G went from ABOUT 18% two years ago to WELL OVER 50% today, and Semtech expects to EXIT this fiscal year (by January) with BETTER THAN 50% share of 1.6T FiberEdge. Now designing to EVERY module provider in its target markets, SEVERAL ON A SOLE-SOURCE BASIS, across both fully-retimed and linear architectures. Driver revenue is still ahead of it ('a wonderful product in the evaluation, will be contributing to the revenue very meaningfully'). CEO: 'we believe our linear equalizer solutions are the de facto industry standard' for ACC — already taking 'the lion's share' of the linear-equalizer market — volume-ready up to 1.6T and in DESIGN-IN AT ALL BANDWIDTHS UP TO 3.2T (1.6T / 2.4T / 3.2T roadmap), on link-margin and power advantages. ACC: 'clear visibility with the leading hyperscalers', volume deployment STARTS FROM Q4 (cable makers already ordering, up QoQ); ACC adoption coincides with NEW PLATFORM designs rather than displacing installed AEC. Broad linear-equalizer-ON-BOARD design activity across multiple hyperscalers, several 'reaching the finish line' near term; interoperability not yet a customer priority (availability first).
set.figure: 800G FiberEdge share ~18% → >50%; 1.6T FiberEdge >50% targeted by fiscal-year exit (January); ACC volume deployment from Q4

items.reason: The CEO's hedge 'we believe' was lost; he said 'leading hyperscalers' (plural) and 'from Q4' / 'by January' without a year, so FY2027 / January 2027 are inferred. Verifier: the CEO said 'designing to every module provider', not designed in.
items.evidence: Hong Hou: ACC, we definitely have the clear visibility with the leading hyperscalers. We are going to be having the volume deployment start from Q4.

set.signal: PHOTONICS BUILD-OUT (HieFo acquired ~5-6 months ago, plus a series of photonic acquisitions completed in under six months): portfolio now spans GAIN CHIPS (the one product shipping in volume today), HIGH-POWER CW LASERS, SEMICONDUCTOR OPTICAL AMPLIFIERS (SOA, now sampling) and newly-added HIGH-SPEED PHOTODIODES / PD ARRAYS (design team brought on under an industry leader, to be co-optimized with Semtech's own TIAs). High-power CW laser sampled to FIVE-SIX MODULE MANUFACTURERS with very positive feedback on power-conversion efficiency, beam and over-temperature performance; one CW laser splits into 4 or 8 channels for 1.6T and 3.2T transceivers. Beyond the THREE ANCHOR gain-chip customers (all increasing demand), new key customers have been added now that Semtech stands behind the asset. Timeline: CW laser + SOA available for customer sampling/qualification within ~2 months; CW-LASER-FOR-TRANSCEIVER REVENUE STARTS H1 FY2028. Content per transceiver targeted to rise from HIGH SINGLE-DIGIT DOLLARS to HIGH DOUBLE-DIGIT DOLLARS as the industry moves 800G → 3.2T — CEO explicitly clarified this means $80-90, NOT $18-19 — coinciding with the 3.2T cut-in. CEO: PD and CW laser products carry DATA-CENTER gross margins, ACCRETIVE to the ~64% post-divestiture corporate average.

items.reason: Wrong speaker: CEO Hong Hou, not CFO Mark Lin, answered the margin question on the new products.
items.evidence: Hong Hou: They should be above. All the areas that you just mentioned, CW lasers especially, they are at a data center gross margin, which is accretive to that corporate gross margin average.

set.signal: CAPACITY, BACKLOG & PRICING: RECORD BACKLOG — CEO: for the remainder of this fiscal year the backlog 'I would say for our target is all booked', and for next fiscal year 'we probably over 70% there'. CEO warns the capacity secured MAY NOT BE ENOUGH to support FY2028, ESPECIALLY H2 FY2028, and says there is room in the industry to secure ANOTHER 50-100% of capacity. Actions: acquired an ALREADY FULLY-FACILITIZED FAB in close proximity to the existing photonics site, raising fab capacity 3-4x BY THE END OF THE YEAR (on track); adding BACK-END TESTERS and qualifying ADDITIONAL OSAT partners (test, packaging, die-separation) partly to MITIGATE GEOPOLITICAL RISK; front-end capacity being expanded with a leading partner via PREPAYMENT / CapEx / other means. CapEx was 2% of net sales in Q2 (fab capacity for gain chips and CW lasers) and is expected to grow but stay GENERALLY BELOW 5% of sales. PRICING: 'availability is more important to the customers than the pricing' — NO price erosion expected in the near term and none on orders already in backlog; CFO: 'We're not really seeing price erosion to 800G.' Input costs rising slightly and being PASSED THROUGH to customers.
set.figure: probably >70% of next fiscal year booked; fab capacity 3-4x by the end of the year; room for 50-100% more capacity; no near-term price erosion expected

items.reason: Hedges 'I would say' / 'probably' were lost on the backlog, the fab ramp was said to be 'by the end of the year' (FY2027 inferred), and the CFO said 'not really seeing' price erosion.

items.signal_prefix: MARKET / ROADMAP DATA POINTS: 800G transceiver INDUSTRY volume

set.signal: MARKET / ROADMAP DATA POINTS: 800G transceiver INDUSTRY volume went from ~20 MILLION UNITS/YEAR two years ago to 'probably 90 million units a year' this year — the industry entered the year forecasting 50M units and Semtech is 'now hearing the number 80, 90 million'; 800G bookings are still INCREASING (not decreasing), and 800G and 1.6T both have 'a really very healthy runway over the next two years'. 3.2T TIMING: design window starts opening in ~12 MONTHS, EARLY MOVERS ~18 MONTHS OUT, MEANINGFUL DEPLOYMENT 'probably in two years' — that is the cut-in for Semtech's content step-up, and above 200G/lane is where TIA + photodiode CO-OPTIMIZATION becomes necessary. MPO/NPO called a strong trend driven by BANDWIDTH-DENSITY limits against fixed shoreline: Semtech is engaged on '10, 15 DIFFERENT PROGRAMS' with module manufacturers, some tied directly to end customers, as a leading supplier of TIA ARRAYS and (linearized) LASER ARRAYS; higher density tightens element spacing and crosstalk, changing packaging requirements. LPO has generated meaningful revenue since Q1 and is growing moderately, but its bigger effect is PROVING THE LINEAR ARCHITECTURE, which now carries into MPO, XPO and 'some form of CPO'. Stated R&D priority: lasers, photodiodes, drivers and TIAs for 3.2T coherent light, XPO, MPO and CPO applications.
set.figure: 800G industry units ~20M/yr two years ago → probably ~90M/yr this year; 3.2T volume ~2 years out; 10-15 MPO/NPO programs
